blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Supply planning is the other half of the balance. First you learn how much customers will want. Then you must decide how much to produce, when to produce it, and where to put it.

A good supply plan matches the forecast. But it also protects the company. It leaves a buffer for delays. It includes safety stock. It schedules production early, so there is no last-minute panic.

Forecasting without supply planning is wishful. Supply planning without forecasting is blind. You need both.

items.q: What three things does a supply plan decide?
options: Who to hire, when, and where
Which supplier, which price, and which country
How much to produce, when, and where to put it
What to sell, to whom, and for how much
items.why: "how much to produce, when to produce it, and where to put it."

items.q: Why does a good plan leave a buffer?
items.why: "It leaves a buffer for delays."

items.q: The text says forecasting without supply planning is…
items.why: "Forecasting without supply planning is wishful."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: A forecast alone is enough to run a company
You should produce only at the last minute
Buffers are a waste of time
A good plan needs both forecasting and supply planning
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que os dois são cegos ou otimistas sozinhos — "You need both."

items.q: Scheduling production early suggests that the company wants to…
items.why: Inferência: programar cedo evita o pânico de última hora que o texto menciona.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie revisando o plano de suprimentos. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, it's Sophie. I am looking at next quarter's supply plan today, and I want to check one thing: is our buffer big enough?

The forecast went up a little this month. Customers want more sugar than we thought. So the plan has to match that new number. Right now, I think the buffer is too small.

Here is my worry. If a shipment is late, and we have no safety stock, we run out. We lose the customer. That is the worst thing. So we need to produce a bit more, just to be safe.

But I don't want too much stock either. Too much stock ties up cash. It sits in the warehouse and does nothing. So I have to find the middle. Not too much, not too little.

My plan is simple. I will raise the safety stock a little, and I will schedule production one week earlier. Then I will check the numbers again next month. A supply plan is never finished. You review it, and you adjust it. Okay, let me start.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie checking today?
options: If the buffer is big enough
The factory schedule for last year
items.why: "is our buffer big enough?"

items.q: What happened to the forecast this month?
items.why: "The forecast went up a little this month."

items.q: What is Sophie's plan?
options: Raise safety stock and schedule production one week earlier
items.why: "I will raise the safety stock a little, and I will schedule production one week earlier."

items.q: Why does Sophie NOT want too much stock?
options: It ties up cash and does nothing
items.why: Inferência: "Too much stock ties up cash. It sits in the warehouse and does nothing."

items.q: What does Sophie mean by "A supply plan is never finished"?
options: Nobody can make a supply plan
The plan is too long to write
You must review and adjust it again and again
items.why: Inferência: ela diz que sempre se revisa e ajusta — nunca é "set and forget".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We keep a buffer in case a shipment is late." A buffer is…
options: an extra amount kept for safety
items.why: Buffer = reserva, uma quantidade extra guardada por segurança.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The plan must ___ the forecast, or we produce the wrong amount."
items.why: To match = corresponder: o plano tem que bater com a previsão.

items.q: "Safety stock is the minimum we keep so we never run out." It is…
options: the extra stock the factory throws away
the most stock we can hold
the smallest amount kept to avoid running out
items.why: Safety stock = estoque de segurança: o mínimo para não faltar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Hoping for the best without a real plan is just ___ thinking."
items.why: Wishful = otimista demais, baseado só em desejo.

items.q: "We schedule production for next week." To schedule means to…
items.why: To schedule = programar, marcar o momento de fazer algo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de planejamento. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the new supply plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new plan region by region." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos, região por região.

items.q: "If we run out of stock, we lose the customer." To run out of means to…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem, acabar o que se tinha.

items.q: "Too much inventory can tie up cash." To tie up means to…
items.why: Tie up = imobilizar, deixar o dinheiro preso e sem uso.

items.q: "We agreed the plan, but nobody followed through." They…
options: did not carry it to the end
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.
